reason: We already have Jurnal set up and my bookkeeper knows it, so I do not want a second tool and a separate Google Sheet to reconcile. My month-end problem is staff not sending the receipts at all, and a bot cannot read a receipt nobody photographed.
objection: It will misread faded or handwritten Indonesian nota and I will end up checking every row myself, on top of what my bookkeeper already does in Jurnal.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into Jurnal and I saw it correctly read a stack of our own faded handwritten nota during the free trial.
